blueprint.label: Production Science 15/s
blueprint.description: 15/s (1/3 belt) - place 3 for a full belt. 4x2 cells. Top left: 88 pack machines in 2 row pairs (rails on the outer belts, furnace | module in the middle). Middle: two rail blocks (32 machines each, 4 one-lane rail belts each, laid as nested L-shapes). Right: stick blocks (10, bulk) and furnace blocks (12). Bottom left: module block (64). Inputs on the east edge, marked by panels.
